# Elias Crew Co.

> Family-owned contractor in McKinney, Texas, serving McKinney and North Dallas–Fort Worth since 2005. Fully insured. Covered patios, pergolas, fences and fence repair, decks, kitchen and bath remodeling, carpentry, painting and flooring, handyman repairs, and Christmas light installation. Free on-site estimates. Call or text 214-836-1418, email eliascrew@gmail.com.

- [Covered Patios & Patio Covers in McKinney](https://eliascrew.com/covered-patios-mckinney): custom cedar patio covers, attached or freestanding, HOA-ready plans
- [Pergola Builder in McKinney](https://eliascrew.com/pergolas-mckinney): custom cedar pergolas, attached or freestanding
